ConnectionStrings.// ODSDpConnection: DISABLED (2026-08-13). DP contracts now read ODSConnection (Dev ODS) like every other ODS query, so local dev behaves the same as deployed Dev/QA/Prod and needs no prod sign-in. The DP Contracts tab is therefore empty locally until ctrm.vw_GNTA70D1 is loaded in the Dev ODS. TO TEMPORARILY POINT DP AT PROD AGAIN (read-only, for validating values against real data), uncomment the key below — it prompts once for your prod-admin account via 'Active Directory Interactive' while the four connections above stay on your normal account. Leave it commented for normal work and never enable it in a deployed environment.

CustomerSync.// RunAtTimeUtc: Empty disables the scheduled sync on dev — local app restarts shouldn't trigger a full sync. Use POST /api/diagnostics/customer-sync/run for on-demand refresh.

AppAccess.// GroupId: Local (env Development) reads the DEV access group. Locally the app authenticates to Graph as the developer's own credential, so this works without any managed-identity grant.

Ctrm.// Source: Local dev opts IN to the CTRM path so the spike is exercised by default. Set to 'ods' (or empty) to fall straight back to the ODS views without touching code.
Ctrm.// GraphQlUri: The renamed Scoular.GraphQL endpoint (AB#33220); /internal/db2/graphql is the retired name and answers identically for now. Points at the QA gateway, not apidev — QA is the environment the API was validated against, and the client secret is a shared nonprod credential.
Ctrm.// ContractDateFrom: Harvest 2025 onward. Sized from measurement, not guesswork: a 500-row page WITH pricing lines costs ~10s, so cost is roughly 10s x pages. This window is 8,827 contracts = 18 pages ~= 3 minutes of background warm-up. For scale, 2025-09-01 is 68 pages (~11 min) and all of 2025 is 221 pages (~40 min) — neither is usable. A 2026-only window loads in ~10s but shows a tester only ~6 contracts for the producers that exist in both systems, because 130 of their 136 DEV ODS contracts are dated 2025.
Ctrm.// MaxPages: 18 pages needed, 40 for headroom. The base default of 5 guards against an accidentally wide window; here the width is deliberate and measured.
Ctrm.// SnapshotMinutes: 12 hours. The walk takes ~3 minutes, so a short TTL would eventually make a tester's request land during a rebuild. Restart the app to force a refresh.
